; Keywords, block types, variables and functions in every case.
SCN TSCaseScript
SHORT Flag
Float Rate

BEGIN gamemode
	IF flag == 0
		SET FLAG TO 1
	ELSEIF FLAG == 1
		Set Rate To getstage tsquest
	ELSE
		setstage TSQUEST 10
	ENDIF
END

Begin GameMode
	if Flag
		SetAV health 50
		player.setav STRENGTH 5
	endIf
End

begin gameMode
end
begin Gamemode
end
